Sandbox_FactionsPlus_DisablePlantRotten_: Farming will no longer have a time limit to harvest after final stage
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_EnableFastRest_tool: Players will restore endurance much faster while using the Rest action on furniture
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_RestEnduranceReceiv: How much endurance to receive per second while resting on furniture
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_EnableFastSleep_too: Players will restore fatigue and endurance much more faster than in vanilla
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_SleepFatigueReducer: How much fatigue will be reduced per second while sleeping
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_SleepEnduranceRecei: How much endurance receive per second  while sleeping
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_EnableCalendarReset: Every day the sandbox starting day will reset to the actual day, so all respawned items will be fresh
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_ReduceSeedDropPerce: How much seed drop will be reduced
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_EnableReduceWaterNe: Crops will need much less water to be fully watered
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_ReduceWaterNeedPerc: How much water will be reduced on watering, 0.5 50% reduce, 1.0 vanilla, 1.5 50% increase
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_WaterLevelIncreaseP: How much less water will be needed to be fully watered, vanilla = 10
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_EnableWaterLightCyc: Water and Light will cycle between days of the week
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_WaterLightCycle_too: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday... example: 0/3/6, Sunday,Wednesday,Saturday the water and lights will be turned on
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_Timezone_tooltip: Timezone from your current location, Sao Paulo: -3, New York: -5, Moscou: 3
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_MessagesCheckPerTic: Every this amount of ticks will try to detect new players or leaved players
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_EnablePlayerJoinMes: When a player joins the server it will display a message with their username
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_EnablePlayerLeaveMe: When a player leaves the server it will display a message with their username
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_EnablePlayerDeathMe: When a player dies in the server it will display a message with their username
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_EnableVehicleClaim_: Allows players to claim a vehicle with /vehicleclaim. Other players won't be able to open its trunk/glovebox to steal items, even if left unlocked
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_VehicleClaimCost_to: Currency cost to claim a vehicle. Set to 0 for free. Requires Factions Economy
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_VehicleClaimMax_too: Maximum number of vehicles a single player can have claimed at the same time. Set to 0 for unlimited
Sandbox_FactionsPlus_VehicleProtectTickI: How many server ticks between each vehicle condition check and restore. Lower = more responsive but more CPU. At 15 FPS, 15 = ~1 second, 150 = ~10 seconds
